# Track Studio 1.2.8

This release adds the NetEase Cloud Music library, moves large components to on-demand downloads, and — most importantly for macOS — signs the app with a Developer ID certificate and notarizes it with Apple, so updates can now install in place.

## New Features

- **macOS Developer ID signing and Apple notarization:** The macOS app is signed with a Developer ID Application certificate and notarized by Apple. macOS no longer reports that the developer cannot be verified, and Gatekeeper opens the app directly.
- **macOS in-app updates:** From this release, macOS updates are delivered through electron-updater: check for updates, download, and the app installs the new version and restarts by itself. The manual download-and-replace flow is only used when the app is running from a mounted disk image or a read-only volume.
- **NetEase Cloud Music library:** Sign in inside the app, browse your NetEase library and playlists, and send tracks to either deck. Downloaded tracks can be analyzed, and analysis results already available are reused instead of being recomputed.
- **NetEase playlist management:** Remove tracks from self-made playlists and from My Music, give the NetEase library its own list settings, and copy tracks into your local library.
- **SET export naming:** When exporting a SET to a folder, audio files can be named `01 Track Name - Artist`.
- **On-demand components:** Base Stem models and the rekordbox environment are downloaded only when they are needed instead of being bundled into the installer, and the rekordbox download entry appears only after a local installation or library is detected.
- **Unified download and update card:** Component downloads and app updates are both reported in one card in the bottom-right corner, and macOS now uses the same card instead of opening a separate update window.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed the re-analyze dialog by folding grid parameters into a collapsible section, added the analysis runtime gate when re-analyzing, and summarized batch failures.
- Improved NetEase Cloud Music interaction, added an explicit sign-out entry, and unified the NetEase interface.
- Fixed dark text and the system border on native buttons using the .button style, and applied the global button style to the download task card.
- Fixed the download task card expanding on its own after an app update finished downloading, and added feedback when a component download is triggered again while one is still running.
- Removed the runtime download prompt from the startup phase, and made runtime hints name the components a feature actually needs.
- Fixed a 2 px vertical overflow in the Mixtape track area that made the view scrollable and kept a vertical scrollbar visible.
- Fixed the light rim around the macOS app icon that showed up in the Dock and Launchpad at small sizes; the icon now follows the macOS icon grid and keeps a clean edge.
- Added an official-site link to the NetEase Cloud Music sign-in dialog for users who are new to the service.

# Track Studio 1.2.8 中文更新说明

本次更新接入网易云曲库，把大体积组件改成按需下载；最关键的是 macOS 终于用 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证，更新也改成应用内原地一键更新。

## 新功能

- **macOS Developer ID 签名与 Apple 公证：** macOS 版本现在使用 Developer ID Application 证书签名并通过 Apple 公证，系统不再提示「无法验证开发者」，Gatekeeper 可直接打开。
- **macOS 应用内原地更新：** 从本版开始，macOS 更新走 electron-updater：检查更新、下载、应用自动安装并重启完成升级。只有当应用正运行在挂载的磁盘映像或只读卷上时，才会退回手动下载替换的方式。
- **网易云曲库：** 在应用内登录网易云音乐，浏览曲库与歌单，并把曲目装到任意一轨。已下载的曲目可以直接分析，已有分析结果会直接复用，不重复计算。
- **网易云歌单管理：** 支持从自建歌单和「我的音乐」移除曲目，网易云库可以使用独立的列表设置，也可以把曲目复制到本地库。
- **SET 导出命名：** SET 导出到文件夹时，音频文件可按 `01 曲名 - 作者` 命名。
- **组件按需下载：** 基础 Stem 模型与 rekordbox 环境改为按需下载，不再塞进安装包；检测到本机已安装 rekordbox 或已有资料库后才显示下载入口。
- **统一下载与更新进度：** 组件下载与应用更新统一在右下角卡片里展示，macOS 也改用这张卡片，不再单独弹出更新窗口。

## 修复与改进

- 重新分析弹窗把网格参数收进可折叠区，重新分析时补上分析运行时门禁，并汇总批次失败情况。
- 完善网易云曲库交互，补上退出登录入口，并统一网易云界面。
- 修掉原生 button 上使用 .button 样式的黑字与系统边框，下载任务卡片按钮改用全局按钮样式。
- 修掉应用更新下载完成后下载任务卡片自动展开的问题，组件下载中再次触发时给出下载中反馈。
- 移除启动阶段的运行时下载提示，运行时提示改为按功能说明所需组件。
- 修复 Mixtape 轨道区竖向多出 2px 导致画面可上下滚动、常显竖向滚动条的问题。
- 修复 macOS 图标在 Dock 与启动台小尺寸下显示一圈白色描边的问题，图标按 macOS 图标网格重建，边缘干净。
- 网易云音乐登录弹窗新增「访问官网」入口，方便不熟悉这个平台的用户了解。

# macOS 用户须知

- 本版起 macOS 包已完成 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证，系统不会再拦截未验证的开发者。
- 从旧版本升级时需要手动替换一次：下载安装包后退出旧版，把 Track Studio 拖进「应用程序」并选择「替换」。
- 替换完成之后，后续版本都可以在应用内「检查更新」直接下载并原地安装，不需要再手动下载安装包。
